decision.headline: Design and test; do not fund or execute yet.
decision.next_step: Prioritize delayed reporting sources and payment root causes; certify mobility before booking value.

gates.boundary: Local purpose, dependencies, signatories, service continuity, closure cost, and fee removal are not validated; Source scope and removability are unresolved; no combined capacity or P&L baseline.
gates.calculation: Closure counts and fees can be filtered by account dimensions; the capacity estimate remains enterprise-global and unfiltered.
gates.formula: Closure candidate fees = Σ annual fees for matching flagged accounts; no closure, capacity, or P&L values are combined.
gates.meaning: Separates closure-validation candidates and management-estimated capacity from values that can be funded or booked.
gates.next_action: Complete local account validation and reconcile observed labor scope before approving closures or booking savings.
gates.title: Open evidence gates

liquidity.boundary: Scenario screen only; no threshold is validated movable cash
liquidity.calculation: For each unflagged account, subtract its trailing supplied-payment buffer from positive estimated availability and floor at zero; then include selected negative positions.
liquidity.formula: Net screen = Σ max(positive availability − trailing buffer, 0) for unflagged accounts + Σ negative availability.
liquidity.meaning: Shows an uncertified 7- or 14-day screening sensitivity for selected accounts as of the selected end date.
liquidity.next_action: Certify restrictions, local operating needs, ownership, and transfer mechanics before assigning movable-cash value.
liquidity.title: Liquidity screening sensitivity

overview.boundary: Supplied diagnostic data only; source certification and operating validation remain open.
overview.calculation: The view presents separate visibility, liquidity-screening, payment, and evidence-gate measures without combining them into a score.
overview.formula: No composite score or recommendation formula is applied.
overview.meaning: A governed Week 1–2 diagnostic view for deciding what to validate next; it is not a live treasury position or execution approval.
overview.next_action: Use filters to isolate a scope, then inspect the relevant evidence before making a funding or execution decision.
overview.title: How to read this dashboard

payments.boundary: Within supplied 7,600 records only; association does not establish cause or ACG-wide performance
payments.calculation: Every matching payment is assigned to exactly one of four priority cohorts; records, exceptions, and repair minutes are summed by cohort.
payments.formula: Priority share = priority-union measure ÷ matching overall measure; the manual-touch/cross-border overlap is counted once.
payments.meaning: Compares the deduplicated manual-touch or cross-border-wire priority union with all matching supplied payment records.
payments.next_action: Validate root causes in the selected high-contribution cohort before designing process changes.
payments.title: Payment friction

quality.boundary: Passing internal checks establishes structural consistency and reconciliation only; it does not certify source completeness, semantic accuracy, operational timing, causation, or decision authority
quality.calculation: Count passing Week 1 checks, reconciled Week 2 controls, and governed source artifacts; present population controls without combining them into a score.
quality.formula: Status = all required internal checks pass and all declared control totals reconcile; no composite data-quality score is calculated.
quality.meaning: Summarizes internal structural checks, reconciled Week 2 controls, governed source artifacts, and the remaining certification boundary.
quality.next_action: Complete source-owner certification and resolve semantic or operational evidence gaps before treating internal consistency as decision authority.
quality.title: Data quality and evidence

regions.boundary: Each comparison row overrides the active region while currency, entity, and bank remain applied. Matching-account counts do not use the date filter; delayed-account and payment evidence use the selected inclusive period; closure candidates use the fixed 30 June 2026 snapshot. Markers are schematic classifications—not bank, account, cash, legal-domicile, or transfer-path locations—and the map is not live.
regions.calculation: Hold the selected date, currency, entity, and bank filters constant, then recalculate each row with its region classification.
regions.formula: Regional measure = the governed measure recomputed for accounts whose region equals NA, EMEA, or APAC; regional rows reconcile to the facet scope.
regions.meaning: Shows governed account, reporting, payment, and closure-diagnostic evidence across the supplied NA, EMEA, and APAC classifications.
regions.next_action: Select a region, then inspect visibility, liquidity, and payment evidence with each measure's own decision boundary.
regions.title: Regional footprint

visibility.boundary: Calendar-date proxy; not start-of-day or elapsed-24-hour visibility
visibility.calculation: For each selected account, take its maximum reporting_delay_days in the period; values above zero are delayed.
visibility.formula: Delayed-account share = delayed selected accounts ÷ selected accounts; same-day rate = delay-0 account-days ÷ selected account-days.
visibility.meaning: Shows how many selected accounts have any calendar-date reporting delay during the selected inclusive period.
visibility.next_action: Prioritize portal and spreadsheet sources with the greatest selected account exposure for reporting remediation.
visibility.title: Reporting visibility

dimensions.boundary: Covers exact duplicates in supplied files only; it does not perform fuzzy identity matching or prove enterprise-population uniqueness.

dimensions.boundary: This does not establish enterprise-population completeness: payment extract controls, receivables, FX transactions, operating-buffer inputs, and other decision evidence remain absent.
dimensions.definition: Whether required supplied values and declared panels are present for the scope being analysed.

dimensions.boundary: Reporting dates contain no receipt timestamps or agreed cutoffs, so the proxy does not establish start-of-day or elapsed-24-hour performance.

dimensions.boundary: Conformance to the supplied file contract does not establish semantic accuracy, business fitness, or source certification.

dimensions.threshold: Technical gate · all mapped schema, type, domain, and range rules pass
